user_problem: Marketers need to compare their own proposed offers without unsupported competitor or demand claims.
unique_output: An internal comparison matrix covering audience, promise, included assets, proof available, friction, and testable distinctions.
test_case: Compare three supplied offers and flag a promise that lacks supporting proof.
overlap_to_check: Market research, campaign briefs, and pricing research.
specific_guardrail: Use supplied evidence and explicit constraints only; missing authority and unknown facts stay unresolved.
